commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.

90+6' Ooh that was close! Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.
90+5' Here comes a substitution. Nawaf Al Abed is given a rest as he is replaced by Hattan Bahebri (Saudi Arabia).
90+4' Abdulrahman Al Oboud (Saudi Arabia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+3' A pass into the penalty area from Abdulrahman Al Oboud (Saudi Arabia) is intercepted by the defence.
90+2' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mohammed Al Owais is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90+2' Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Poland have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+1' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Poland have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
89' Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nasser Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia).
89' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
87' Abdulrahman Al Oboud (Saudi Arabia) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.

81' Krzysztof Piatek (Poland) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
81' Firas Al Buraikan (Saudi Arabia) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

80' Sultan Al Ghannam (Saudi Arabia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.
79' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
79' That was close. Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.

77' Sultan Al Ghannam (Saudi Arabia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Wilton Sampaio with no other option than to blow for a foul.
77' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
76' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
76' The attendance is 44259.
75' Mohammed Al Owais displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Robert Lewandowski (Poland) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
74' A cross from Saleh Al Shehri (Saudi Arabia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
73' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
71' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

70' Jakub Kaminski (Poland) is penalised for a foul. Wilton Sampaio had a clear view and blows his whistle.

69' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
68' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from 20 metres out by Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) as his effort only hit the wall.
67' Referee Wilton Sampaio sees the trip by Krystian Bielik (Poland) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick to Saudi Arabia.
66' Post! Robert Lewandowski (Poland) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
65' Herve Renard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sultan Al Ghannam (Saudi Arabia) replacing Mohammed Al Breik.
64' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle after Saud Abdulhamid (Saudi Arabia) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
63' Arkadiusz Milik (Poland) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jakub Kaminski (Poland) is coming onto the pitch as Piotr Zielinski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Good movement by Mohammed Al Breik (Saudi Arabia), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
62' Dangerous play by Robert Lewandowski (Poland). Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.

61' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.

60' Firas Al Buraikan (Saudi Arabia) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
58' Matty Cash (Poland) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
58' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
57' Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

55' The ball rebounds back to Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) on the edge of the box and he produces another shot, just to see it fly wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.

55' Well-positioned Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!

54' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.
54' Krystian Bielik (Poland) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

53' Saleh Al Shehri (Saudi Arabia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Wilton Sampaio blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
53' Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
52' Matty Cash (Poland) probably handled the ball.
51' Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
51' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
51' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
50' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) picks up an injury.
49' Wilton Sampaio interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia).
49' Mohammed Al Breik (Saudi Arabia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
48' Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

48' Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) commits a rough foul. Wilton Sampaio stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Saudi Arabia, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
47' Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) prepares to take a corner kick.
47' The ball is cleared after Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Saudi Arabia will take a corner.
46' Substitution. Nawaf Al Abed (Saudi Arabia) has come on for Sami Al Najei.
46' The second half gets underway.

45+6' Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+5' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+4' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) has tested the patience of referee Wilton Sampaio and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+2' Saudi Arabia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+2' Mohammed Al Breik (Saudi Arabia) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping. It will be a corner kick for Saudi Arabia.

45+1' Wojciech Szczesny anticipates the direction of the penalty by Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
45+1' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

41' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

38' Ali Al Boleahi (Saudi Arabia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Ali Al Boleahi (Saudi Arabia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

30' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Robert Lewandowski (Poland), but the defence gets it clear.
29' A player from Saudi Arabia commits a rough challenge. Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
27' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' Krystian Bielik (Poland) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Poland force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
26' Matty Cash (Poland) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Poland win a corner.
25' A long ball forward to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) is intercepted.
23' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
22' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Poland are taking a throw-in.
20' Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) will miss the next game.

20' The game is interrupted. Matty Cash (Poland) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
19' Arkadiusz Milik (Poland) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Wilton Sampaio had an easy-decision to make.

19' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
17' Mohammed Al Breik (Saudi Arabia) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny.
16' Matty Cash (Poland) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
15' Wilton Sampaio shows a yellow card to Jakub Kiwior (Poland) for his blatant foul.
13' The corner is swung in but Saudi Arabia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Saudi Arabia are going to take it.
12' Matty Cash (Poland) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle after Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
10' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Piotr Zielinski (Poland), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' There's an opportunity for Sami Al Najei (Saudi Arabia) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Mohammed Al Breik (Saudi Arabia) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Saudi Arabia win a corner kick.
6' Matty Cash (Poland) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mohammed Al Owais intercepts the ball.
4' Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Wilton Sampaio no option but to blow his whistle.
4' Abdulelah Al Malki (Saudi Arabia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

2' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) makes a rough challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
